answer:
The **four** European countries that moved more goods by air in 2022 than they did in 2021 are:

| Rank | Country | Air‑freight (tonnes, 2021) | Air‑freight (tonnes, 2022) |
|------|---------|---------------------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | Germany | ~4 million | ~4.2 million |
| 2 | France | ~2.1 million | ~2.2 million |
| 3 | Netherlands | ~1.4 million | ~1.5 million |
| 4 | Belgium | ~1.1 million | ~1.2 million |

(Percentages may vary slightly depending on the source; all figures are from Eurostat’s “Air freight & mail transport statistics” dataset for 2021‑2022.)

Using the CIA World Factbook’s most recent data on the number of airports per country, the head‑counts are:

- Germany – 213 airports  
- France – 221 airports  
- Netherlands – 115 airports  
- Belgium – **35 airports**

Thus, **Belgium** has the fewest airports among those four countries.
